opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__facts:
This is first application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant in connection with Crime No.645/2021 registered at Police Station - Gogawa, Khargone (M.P.) under Section 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of the IPC, 3/4,5L/6 of the POCSO Act, 3(2)(va), 3(2)(v),
3(1)(w)(i) of the SC/ST Act.
The applicant is in jail since 19.02.2022.
The statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded.
The applicant is not in a position to influence the prosecutrix.
opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__arguments:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the court statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded and in the cross-examination, she did not recognize the applicant and also denied the allegations of rape.
She has stated that her age is 19 years.
Learned counsel for the respondent/state has opposed the prayer and submits that the prosecutrix has supported the case in her examination-in-chief.
opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__ANALYSIS:
There is no scholar register to prove the age of the prosecutrix.
As per ossification test, the age of prosecutrix is 15-17 years.
As per law, the ossification test assumption varies two years either side.
opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__decision:
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration para 6 and 7 of the statement of the prosecutrix, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
It is directed that applicant shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.
The prison authorities are also requested to ensure compliance with the order passed by the Supreme Court IN RE : CONTAGION OF COVID 19 VIRUS IN PRISONS in SUO MOTU "W.P. (C)
No.1/2020" and ensure that the applicant is examined by the jail doctor before his release.
If the applicant shows symptoms of COVID-19, the doctor shall forthwith direct him to be produced before the appropriate hospital designated for the detection and treatment of COVID-19 patients.
If the doctor is of the opinion that the applicant is not affected with the virus, the jail authorities shall ensure his transportation from the jail till his place of residence.
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.

Thus it is clear that the power under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. is not to be exercised in the prosecutions which involve heinous and serious offences of mental depravity like murder, rape,
dacoity, etc.
Therefore, the application for quashment of FIR on the basis of compromise is hereby rejected.
Since the applicant himself was a married person, therefore, he was aware of the fact that his second marriage during the subsistence of first marriage is not possible.
Therefore, it is clear that in fact the applicant has voluntarily made the prosecutrix to believe that she is the legally wedded wife of the applicant.
Furthermore, consent of the prosecurix was obtained by misconception of fact and,
therefore, in the light of Section 90 of IPC, her consent cannot be said to be a free consent.
Furthermore, IA No.8490/2022 was filed by previous counsel alleging that by flouting the orders passed by the Court, applicant has shifted to Canada.
Thus, it is clear that even otherwise the applicant has left the country without permission of the Court.
